whoItsFor: Developers running the DSH agent runtime who want runtime injection and task-aware reasoning-mode routing, installed as a bundle of injector, router presets, and a graded task protocol.
useCases: Hot-reload and inject runtime management tools into a running DSH session without restarting
Route each task to a reasoning mode (spec, react, mixed, or weak) with a per-model persona preset
Run a graded two-level task protocol with checkpoints, a red-team gate, and an audit endpoint
